#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
task_root="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${GENOS_DEV:-$HOME/DEV}}"
task_logs="$task_root/TRANSFER/cm-shortcut-data-r2/logs"
if ! mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; then task_logs="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-cm-data-$(id -u)"; mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; fi
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "CM_DATA_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"' EXIT
printf "LOG=%s\n" "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
python3 - --root "$task_root" "$@" <<'CM_DATA_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='98df7ec775008eb0266856ab5aab418271fdbb0111d694a8bb1e0f5c93b94111'
bundle=json.loads(raw); module=types.ModuleType('cm_handoff')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'apply_cm.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
try:raise SystemExit(module.dispatch(bundle['spec'],sys.argv[1:]))
except Exception as exc:
 print('CM_DATA FAILED: '+str(exc),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(1)
CM_DATA_PY
